appDescription.message: Sniffs downloadable media on the current page, with deep Bilibili support and on-demand novel text extraction.

onboardingStep1Body.message: Open any page, play a video or scroll an image gallery — WebGrab automatically captures downloadable media in the background.

onboardingStep2Body.message: Click the toolbar icon to see the resource list. Download one at a time or select several, and pack comics into CBZ / novels into EPUB.

onboardingStep3Body.message: When resources are found, a floating companion appears in the bottom-right corner — click it to open the resource panel without using the toolbar icon.
